title: IPFS CIDv1 Computer
description: Computes a deterministic IPFS CIDv1 (SHA-256 multihash, multibase base32) for any text input using a pure-JavaScript SHA-256 implementation. Output is byte-exact with go-ipfs and js-ipfs for the same UTF-8 input. Includes self-verified known test vector.

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_ipfs_cid
mcp_tool_definition.description: Computes a deterministic IPFS CIDv1 (SHA-256 multihash, multibase base32) for any text input. Known vector: 'hello world' -> bafkreifzjut3te2nhyekklss27nh3k72ysco7y32koao5eei66wof36n5e.
